content_sections.heading: GEU Research Associate Vacancy Details (Post-wise)
content_sections.text: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Research Associate position under the DBT-sanctioned project.

rows.qualification_required: Ph.D. in Food Technology / Food Processing / Food Engineering or a relevant discipline. Candidates having research experience during Ph.D./Postdoctoral research in plant proteins, protein characterization, food processing, extrusion technology, meat analogues, or related areas will be preferred. Candidates having NET and relevant research experience during their Ph.D. will be preferred.

faq.question: Q1. What is the GEU Research Associate recruitment?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment notification released by Graphic Era University for hiring 1 Research Associate under a DBT-sanctioned research project.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the GEU Research Associate post?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy available for the Research Associate position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for GEU Research Associate recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application by email is 13 October 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for GEU Research Associate?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a Ph.D. in Food Technology, Food Processing, Food Engineering, or a relevant discipline, with a preference for research experience in plant proteins, meat analogues, or related areas.

faq.question: Q5. What is the upper age limit for GEU Research Associate?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 40 years as on the last date of application, with relaxations applicable for reserved categories and women.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for GEU Research Associate?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for GEU Research Associate?
faq.answer: Interested candidates can send their detailed CV via email to [email protected].

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for GEU Research Associate?
faq.answer: Selection will be carried out through an online interview scheduled for 15 October 2026 at 12:00 noon.

faq.question: Q9. What is the salary of the GEU Research Associate?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive Rs 58,000/- per month plus HRA as per Institute norms.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent position?
faq.answer: No, the position is purely temporary for a tenure of 2 years and does not confer any claim for regular appointment at the University.
